description: Find the longest common region (longest common substring) between two nucleotide sequences. Case-insensitive; only A/C/G/T match, N / IUPAC codes / other symbols match nothing and end a region. strands: Forward (default) | ReverseComplement | Both (the region may be shared with the reverse complement of the second sequence; position2 is then the forward-strand start of the window that spells it and isReverseComplement is true). maxMismatches > 0: the longest pair of equal-length windows that differ in at most that many positions (Hamming, no gaps; Flouri et al. 2015), returned with region2 and the mismatch count. Cancellation is checked before and after the search (the search itself is not interruptible).

sequence1.description: The first nucleotide sequence (A/C/G/T plus IUPAC codes such as N, case-insensitive)

strands.description: Which strands of the second sequence (case-insensitive): Forward (default) | ReverseComplement | Both

maxMismatches.description: Largest number of mismatching positions of the two windows (default 0 = exact common substring)

isReverseComplement.description: true for a region shared with the reverse complement of sequence2; omitted when false

mismatches.description: with maxMismatches > 0: mismatching positions of the window pair; omitted otherwise

region2.description: with maxMismatches > 0: the window of the second sequence (reverse-complement strand for a reverse region); omitted otherwise

errors.message: Sequence1 cannot be null or empty
Sequence2 cannot be null or empty
